تستعجلون (form X)
# تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ (tastaʕjilūna) /tas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# تُسْتَعْجَلُونَ (tustaʕjalūna) /tus.taʕ.d͡ʒa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
